args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@gideon.sato Draft incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (Vantorre, Hartford), built from #inc-vtg-hartford:

Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks went offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected. Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Kiosk 1 restored: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on during the reconnect attempts, and the reconnect log went to Carrowmere Cloud.
- Open item: the status-page access problem for Mateo's login is still being worked, tracked in INC-4821. The admin account can already open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals.

Please check the times and wording before it goes out. I have not sent or emailed anything.

I posted the draft in #strategic-random as a reply for you. It uses only #inc-vtg-hartford, which you are in:

- **First report:** 10:42 AM, 3 Aug 2026. Gate kiosks went offline and both inbound lanes showed a white screen.
- **Kiosk 1 back:** 11:03 AM, when trailer 8836 was checked in.

I also included the open status-page access issue (INC-4821). The draft contains no money terms, so nothing needed approval. I haven't emailed it to Mateo or anyone else.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026 (for Mateo Quiroga's procurement team, Vantorre)

- First report: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks went offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was affected. Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Cause work: Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on during the reconnect attempts, and the reconnect log went to Odile.
- Kiosk 1 restored: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 was checked in and dispatch could see it.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's login is still being worked, tracked in INC-4821. The admin account can already open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals.

Not sent to anyone outside this channel.

I posted the final version in #strategic-random as its own message starting with "FINAL:". It adds Odile's gateway route check and INC-4821, and uses only #inc-vtg-hartford, which you are in.

One wording problem: the line I labelled "Cause work" says more than the source does. The channel only shows Carrowmere checking the gateway route, not a cause. Should I post a corrected FINAL with that line changed to "Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) was checking the Hartford gateway route"?
